# mv: method to function where receiver is named but params are unnamed
mv T.M F
-- x.go --
package p

type T struct{}

func (t T) M(int, string) {}

func f() {
	var t T
	t.M(1, "x")
}
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -2,9 +2,9 @@

 type T struct{}

-func (t T) M(int, string) {}
+func F(t T, _ int, _ string) {}

 func f() {
 	var t T
-	t.M(1, "x")
+	F(t, 1, "x")
 }
